method: The same complete 133 pre-turn observations from all 14 original boss games, including wins and losses. Replay and state hashes checked; each replay validated first. Fresh NOISE=0 instances, init outside clock, alternating baseline/candidate order; nominal 486/36 ms and ample 60000 ms. Only past recorded actions reconstruct observations. No current/future recorded enemy actions enter either policy or the placement-only income checks. Known useful cells come from the previously saved exhaustive own-placement probe without sabotage or enemy construction. Candidate availability, exact cell evaluation, complete scenario comparison and eventual choice are separate. One completed attack comparison includes every modeled enemy reply; it need not include both own sabotage alternatives. Repeated observations are not independent trials. This is mechanism evidence, not original arena timing/RNG, a strength test, recoverable match points or process readiness.
